snippet.title: Maze It Out Official Trailer - Out Now
snippet.description:
Calm the storm within. Inspired by mindfulness techniques, this unique puzzle game helps you visualize and manage anxious thoughts. Instead of being overwhelmed, you'll focus on a single thought, bring it into your mental space, and simply Maze It Out.
